_about: R7-W5 (A-104, design 7.4 S5) the Jupiter v6 aggregator program (named here, its id is a constant of ext-verify.ts) and the swap instructions the wallet verifier accepts. EXACT-IN ONLY: the exact-out, token-ledger and every other discriminator is refused. ext-verify.ts JUPITER_EXACT_IN_PINS equals this file (a test keeps them equal).
discriminatorRule: the first 8 bytes of sha256("global:<instruction name>"), computed locally with node:crypto

tail._about: the fixed-size tail of the instruction data, read from the END (the route plan in front of it is variable): in_amount u64, quoted_out_amount u64, slippage_bps u16, platform_fee_bps u8

positionsStatus: NOT FETCHED: this build had no network access. The account positions are those of the published Jupiter v6 IDL as recalled by the author; the discriminators above are recomputed by the test. Before go-live the owner re-checks the positions against the published IDL (docs/rebuild/CUTOVER.md wallet line). A wrong position only makes the verifier refuse a real route (fail closed): nothing unsafe is accepted.
